_note: 幕2/3の継ぎ物 (生き物に古代の部品を継いだもの＝獣の画材＋金属の継ぎ手) (2026-09-11 ユーザー「2,3幕の敵画像もpixellab作成して適用して」)。種の記述は workflow enemy-art-descriptions-act23。各2シード (23,41) から選ぶ。form_ja: enemy_crossbow_archer=背に弩を据えたカメレオン（岩の上から狙う）; enemy_shield_squire=肩に鉄板の大盾を継いだアルマジロ（低く構える）; enemy_chimera_1=継ぎはぎの四足獣・額に鉄板（頭突き）・番号札の鉄首輪; enemy_chimera_2=同じ継ぎはぎの四足獣・痩せて前脚が真鍮の鉤刃の熊手に（刃が一本増えている）; enemy_chimera_3=同じ継ぎはぎの四足獣・後脚にピストン継ぎ手で跳躍の構え・喉に淡く光る真鍮の排気口; enemy_frog_knight=板金を継いだ蛙・脇に錐の槍・跳ぶ構え
style: pixel art in the style of a gentle watercolor picture book illustration of a pale creature that grew up beside a glowing ore vein deep in the ground, body of soft pale grey-white moss-like fur faintly glowing from within, soft rounded simplified body, slightly big head, tiny face with two small round black bead eyes looking slightly down and no mouth, plain cheeks with no blush marks, serene quiet and a little lonely, palette of cream paper, pale silver, faded sage, dusty blue-grey and ink, thin dark ink outline, soft shading like watercolor washes, low contrast, with two or three mismatched parts of tarnished pale metal grafted onto the body: a riveted plate, a brass joint with a small cog, a small pale glowing lens, stitched seams where metal meets fur
